de.abas.erp.common.type.enums

Enum EnumValuation

  • Object
    • Enum<EnumValuation>
      • EnumValuation
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    AbasEnum, AbasType, Serializable, Cloneable, Comparable<EnumValuation>

    public enum EnumValuation
extends Enum<EnumValuation>
implements AbasEnum
    This java enum represents the standard abas erp enumeration Valuation (A1).
    It is independent from a specific ERP client.
